en.AddressPlaceholder: Feed URL, page link or RSSHub route
en.AddressHelp: Links to YouTube, Bilibili, X, GitHub, Telegram and Weibo are turned into feeds.
en.Title: Title
en.SuggestVideo: Most entries in this feed are videos.
en.SuggestImage: Most entries in this feed are pictures.
en.KeepHelp: Older entries are removed. Starred entries are always kept.
en.PaceHelp: Unread entries fade and leave All and Unread when their time is up. Search, Starred and this subscription still show them.
en.ExtractHelp: For feeds whose full text comes out wrong. Empty fields use automatic extraction.
en.ExtractSelectorHelp: A CSS selector for the element that holds the article. If it matches nothing, automatic extraction is used.
en.ExtractSelectorInvalid: The content selector is not a valid CSS selector.
en.ExtractRefererHelp: Sent with the request for the entry page. Nothing else is added.
en.ExtractRefererInvalid: The Referer must be a full http or https address.
en.HeadersHelp: For sites that only answer a certain browser or page. Empty fields send Oriel’s own.
en.HeaderUaHelp: Sent when this subscription is fetched, and when its entry pages are. Empty sends Oriel/{version}.
en.HeaderRefererHelp: Sent when this subscription is fetched. Entry pages use the Referer under Extraction.
en.HeadersNote: Cookies and sign-in are not supported. The headers go only to this subscription’s own site, never to a place it redirects to. A site that blocks Oriel stays blocked.
en.HeaderUaError: Use one line of plain characters, up to 500. A header such as Cookie can’t go here.
en.HeaderRefererError: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://.
en.ExtractRewritesHelp: One per line, from => to: a host (www.example.com => m.example.com) or an address prefix (https://example.com/a/ => https://example.com/b/). Top to bottom; the entry link is rewritten before it is fetched.
en.ExtractRewritesInvalid: A link rewrite must read from => to, with two hosts or two http or https prefixes; at most 10.
en.NoneFound: No feed found at this address. “Add” tries it as typed.
en.PreviewEmpty: This route has no entries yet.
en.PreviewNotFound: RSSHub did not return a feed for this route. Check the parameters.
en.NoCatalog: Can’t read the route catalog of your RSSHub. Type a route yourself, for example /github/issue/user/repo.
en.NoRoutes: No route of your RSSHub fits this.
en.PublicNote: The public rsshub.app often blocks automated requests.
en.PublicNoInstance: The public rsshub.app usually blocks Oriel’s requests. Add your own RSSHub instance in Settings → RSSHub.
en.NeedsBase: RSSHub routes need an RSSHub instance. Enter its address; it is saved in Settings.
en.BaseRequired: Enter the address of your RSSHub instance.
en.InvalidBase: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
en.InvalidAddress: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://, or a route starting with /.
en.Unreachable: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
en.Failed: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
en.MarkOlder1: Mark older than 1 day as read
en.MarkOlder7: Mark older than 1 week as read
en.MarkOlder30: Mark older than 1 month as read
en.ServedByBackupHint: The first address in Settings → RSSHub did not answer, so the next one was used.
en.BlockedPublic: The public rsshub.app blocks automated requests. Use your own or another RSSHub instance in Settings → RSSHub.
en.FeedRemoved: This site says the feed was removed for good. Consider pausing or unsubscribing.
en.Paused: Paused. Nothing is fetched until you resume.
en.MuteHelp: One per line. Entries whose title or summary contains one are hidden; starred ones stay.
en.DeleteBody: All its entries go too, starred ones included. You can undo this for a few seconds.
en.AutoHelp: Only entries that arrive after you turn it on.
en.PromptPlaceholder: Empty uses the prompt in Settings
en.AIOff: AI isn’t set up, so nothing is summarized or translated yet.
en.HealthSub: Sources that need a decision. Nothing changes until you choose.
en.HealthError: Couldn’t check your subscriptions. Try again.
en.HealthRare: Read {read} of {n} new {n:entry|entries} in the last {days} {days:day|days}
en.MovedExists: That address is already subscribed as “{name}”. Unsubscribe from one of them.
en.MovedExistsUnknown: That address is already subscribed. Unsubscribe from one of them.
en.MovedChanged: The move suggestion changed, take another look

zh-Hans.AddressPlaceholder: 订阅地址、主页链接或 RSSHub 路由
zh-Hans.AddressHelp: YouTube、哔哩哔哩、X、GitHub、Telegram 和微博的链接会自动转成订阅。
zh-Hans.Title: 标题
zh-Hans.SuggestVideo: 这个订阅的条目大多是视频。
zh-Hans.SuggestImage: 这个订阅的条目大多是图片。
zh-Hans.KeepHelp: 更早的条目会被清理，收藏的条目一直保留。
zh-Hans.PaceHelp: 未读条目到期前会逐渐变淡，到期后离开全部和未读；搜索、收藏和该订阅里仍能看到。
zh-Hans.ExtractHelp: 抽取出的正文不对时使用。留空则用自动抽取。
zh-Hans.ExtractSelectorHelp: 用 CSS 选择器指出装着文章的元素；匹配不到时改用自动抽取。
zh-Hans.ExtractSelectorInvalid: 正文选择器不是有效的 CSS 选择器。
zh-Hans.ExtractRefererHelp: 抓取条目页面时带上，不会再添加别的请求头。
zh-Hans.ExtractRefererInvalid: Referer 必须是完整的 http 或 https 地址。
zh-Hans.HeadersHelp: 有些站点只认特定的浏览器或来源页时使用。留空则发 Oriel 自己的。
zh-Hans.HeaderUaHelp: 抓取这个订阅和它的条目页面时带上。留空则发 Oriel/{version}。
zh-Hans.HeaderRefererHelp: 抓取这个订阅时带上；条目页面用「正文抽取」里的 Referer。
zh-Hans.HeadersNote: 不支持 cookie 和登录。这些请求头只发给这个订阅自己的站点，被重定向到别处时不带。被站点拦截的订阅仍然是被拦截。
zh-Hans.HeaderUaError: 请填一行普通字符，最多 500 个；Cookie 之类的请求头不能写在这里。
zh-Hans.HeaderRefererError: 请填完整的地址，以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。
zh-Hans.ExtractRewritesHelp: 每行一条，from => to：可以改写主机（www.example.com => m.example.com），也可以改写地址前缀（https://example.com/a/ => https://example.com/b/）。从上到下依次应用，改写后才抓取条目链接。
zh-Hans.ExtractRewritesInvalid: 链接改写必须写成 from => to，两边同为主机或同为 http、https 前缀，最多 10 条。
zh-Hans.FoundBilibili: 哔哩哔哩 · 用户 {name} 的视频
zh-Hans.FoundMany: 找到 {n} 个订阅，选一个。
zh-Hans.NoneFound: 这个地址下没有找到订阅。点「添加」会按原样试一次。
zh-Hans.FoundRoutes: 找到 {n} 条路由，选一条。
zh-Hans.PreviewEmpty: 这条路由暂时没有内容。
zh-Hans.PreviewNotFound: RSSHub 没有为这条路由返回订阅。检查一下参数。
zh-Hans.NoCatalog: 读不到 RSSHub 的路由目录。直接填路由，比如 /github/issue/用户/仓库。
zh-Hans.NoRoutes: 你的 RSSHub 上没有合适的路由。
zh-Hans.PublicNote: 公共的 rsshub.app 常常拦下自动请求。
zh-Hans.PublicNoInstance: 公共的 rsshub.app 通常会拦下 Oriel 的请求。到设置 → RSSHub 填你自己的实例。
zh-Hans.UseMine: 改用我的 RSSHub 实例
zh-Hans.NeedsBase: RSSHub 路由要先有一个 RSSHub 实例。填上它的地址，会存进设置。
zh-Hans.BaseRequired: 填上 RSSHub 实例的地址。
zh-Hans.InvalidBase: 填完整地址（以 http:// 或 https:// 开头）。
zh-Hans.InvalidAddress: 填完整地址（以 http:// 或 https:// 开头），或以 / 开头的路由。
zh-Hans.Unreachable: 连不上服务端。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.Failed: 服务端出了点问题，再试一次。
zh-Hans.MarkOlder1: 把 1 天前的标为已读
zh-Hans.MarkOlder7: 把 1 周前的标为已读
zh-Hans.MarkOlder30: 把 1 个月前的标为已读
zh-Hans.ServedByBackupHint: 设置 → RSSHub 里的第一个地址没有响应，所以换用了后面的地址。
zh-Hans.Blocked: 这个网站拦下了自动阅读器。
zh-Hans.BlockedPublic: 公共的 rsshub.app 拦下了自动请求。到设置 → RSSHub 用你自己的或别的 RSSHub 实例。
zh-Hans.FeedRemoved: 这个网站说订阅已被永久移除，建议暂停或退订。
zh-Hans.Paused: 已暂停，恢复之前不抓取。
zh-Hans.MuteHelp: 每行一个。标题或摘要里有的条目会隐藏，收藏的除外。
zh-Hans.DeleteBody: 它的条目会一起删掉，收藏的也是。删除后几秒内可以撤销。
zh-Hans.AutoHelp: 只管打开之后新到的条目。
zh-Hans.PromptPlaceholder: 留空就用设置里的 prompt
zh-Hans.AIOff: 还没配置 AI，暂时不会摘要或翻译。
zh-Hans.HealthSub: 这些订阅需要你来决定。你不选，什么都不会变。
zh-Hans.HealthError: 没能检查订阅，再试一次。
zh-Hans.HealthSilent: 已有 {n} 天没有新条目
zh-Hans.HealthRare: 近 {days} 天新增 {n} 条，只读了 {read} 条
zh-Hans.HealthNumbers: 近 {days} 天：新增 {recent} 条，已读 {read} 条，收藏 {starred} 条
zh-Hans.MovedExists: 那个地址已经订阅过了，叫“{name}”。请退订其中一个。
zh-Hans.MovedExistsUnknown: 那个地址已经订阅过了。请退订其中一个。
zh-Hans.MovedChanged: 搬家的建议变了，请再看一下
